name: 3Up Shed (Equal Turns)
summary: Three players shed a 10-card hand onto a shared pile by matching or beating its top rank. They wipe the pile with three of a rank or a Clear, or pick it up when stuck. The first seats to run out of cards win, and every seat gets the same number of turns.

player.meaning: Cards in this seat's secret hand (ranks 1-9 and C).
Every distinct 3-card set from the dealt hand, each written ascending with C above 9, and the list sorted ascending. Used only at setup.
The seat's face-up cards. It is played from only once the hand is empty.
Number of cards in the hand.
Number of cards in the up_pile.
hand_count + up_count. This is the score: lower is better.
True once cards_left = 0. The seat then skips its turns.
How many times this seat has picked up the pile.

game.meaning: The Low stack (ranks 1-3), shuffled at setup.
The Mid stack (ranks 4-6), shuffled at setup.
The High stack (ranks 7-9), shuffled at setup.
Cards currently on the shared play pile.
Rank on top of the pile. 0 means the pile is empty.
How many cards of top_rank have been played in a row on the pile.
The seat that takes the first turn this round.
Set true after a round in which at least one seat is out.

setup: Shuffle low_stack, mid_stack and high_stack separately.

In seat order 1, 2, 3, move the top 3 cards of low_stack, then the top 3 of mid_stack, then the top 3 of high_stack, then 1 card of clear_stack into that seat's hand. Each hand then holds 10 cards and every stack is empty.
For each seat, set up_offer to every distinct set of 3 cards from its hand. Each set is written ascending with C counting as 10, and the list is sorted ascending.
Poll all seats at once. Each picks one set from its own up_offer; a missing or invalid answer takes the first set listed.
Move each seat's chosen 3 cards from hand to up_pile. Up piles are public; hands stay secret.
For each seat set hand_count = 7, up_count = 3, cards_left = 10, out = false, picked_up = 0.
Set pile = [], top_rank = 0, run_count = 0, round = 0, game_over = false.

round.who: each player in turn, starting at seat lead, then lead+1, then lead+2 (seat 3 is followed by seat 1); a seat with out = true is skipped
round.answer: One option from the legal plays drawn from the source (hand if hand_count > 0, otherwise up_pile). An option is a rank r with r >= top_rank played as k copies, for k = 1 up to min(3, copies of r held); or a single C; or PICK UP only if no play is legal. Options are listed by ascending rank, then by copies, with C last. A missing or invalid answer takes the first option.
round.effect: Right after each seat answers, its choice is applied as in the next step, so the next seat sees the updated pile.

round.who: the seat that just answered (applied after each turn)
round.effect: Rank play r x k: move k cards of rank r from the source to pile; if top_rank == r then run_count += k, else run_count = k; top_rank = r; if run_count >= 3, clear pile (removed from game), top_rank = 0, run_count = 0. C: remove the C from the source and clear pile (both removed from game), top_rank = 0, run_count = 0. PICK UP: append all of pile to hand, pile = [], picked_up += 1, top_rank = 0, run_count = 0. Then hand_count = len(hand), up_count = len(up_pile), cards_left = hand_count + up_count; if cards_left == 0 then out = true.
After all three turns: if the number of seats with out = true is at least 1, set game_over = true.
End the game if game_over == true or round == 20; otherwise start the next round.

ending.decided_by: Fewest cards_left wins. If a seat went out, every seat with cards_left = 0 shares the win (one such seat wins alone; two or three is a draw). If round 20 ends with nobody out, the seat with the fewest cards_left wins, and seats tied for fewest share it (a draw).

rules.text: When setup is done, each seat has hand_count 7, up_count 3 and cards_left 10. Its 10 dealt cards were 3 Low (1-3), 3 Mid (4-6), 3 High (7-9) and 1 C.
When a seat picks its up set at setup, then exactly those 3 cards move from hand to the public up_pile, and an invalid or missing pick takes the first set of up_offer.
When a round starts, round increases by 1 and lead = ((round - 1) mod 3) + 1, so rounds 1, 2, 3, 4 are led by seats 1, 2, 3, 1.
When a seat has hand_count > 0, then its legal plays come only from its hand; when hand_count = 0, they come only from its up_pile.
When top_rank = t > 0, then a rank r is offered only if r >= t, as 1 to min(3, copies held) copies, and a single C is always offered if held.
When top_rank = 0, then every rank held in the source is offered (1 up to the copies held, at most 3) and C if held.
When no rank or C play is legal, then PICK UP is the only option.
When a seat plays k cards of rank r and top_rank was already r, then run_count increases by k; otherwise run_count = k. In both cases top_rank = r.
When run_count reaches 3 or more after a play, then pile is emptied out of the game, top_rank = 0 and run_count = 0.
When a seat plays a C, then the C and the whole pile leave the game, top_rank = 0 and run_count = 0.
When a seat picks up, then every card of pile goes into its hand, pile becomes empty, picked_up increases by 1, top_rank = 0 and run_count = 0.
When any turn ends, then hand_count, up_count and cards_left = hand_count + up_count are recomputed, and cards_left = 0 sets out = true.
When a seat has out = true, then it is skipped: it is asked nothing and its attributes do not change.
When a missing or invalid answer is given on a turn, then the first listed option is applied.
When a round's three turns end with at least one seat out, then game_over = true and the game ends after that round, so every seat has had the same number of turns.
When round 20 ends, then the game ends even if nobody is out.
When the game ends, then the seats with the lowest cards_left win, and seats tied at the lowest share the win.

offers.question: Setup: choose your up set
offers.options: Every distinct 3-card set from that seat's own 10-card hand, each ascending with C above 9, the list sorted ascending (up_offer).

offers.question: Turn: choose a play
offers.who: the seat whose turn it is, if out = false
offers.options: From the source (hand if not empty, else up_pile): each rank r >= top_rank held, as 1, 2 or 3 copies up to the number held; 'C' if a C is held. When top_rank = 0, every held rank is offered. Sorted by rank, then by copies, with C last. If none of these exist: only 'PICK UP'.

choices.why: The designer fixed the table at 3. Rotating the lead over 3 seats and the equal-turns ending are built for that count.
The source has no talk. Turns are sequential and fully specified, so adding talk would add a mechanic.
A seat that is out has cards_left 0, the lowest possible. Ranking by fewest cards therefore picks exactly the out seats when game_over is true, and the fewest-cards seat at round 20.
The source says C counts above 9, so a numeric stand-in of 10 keeps the ordering.

simplifications.what: A shared top rank is a shared win
simplifications.why: The engine has no separate draw. The source's draw (two or three seats out, or a tie for fewest at round 20) becomes a shared win among the tied seats.

simplifications.what: The turn rotation is described as 'each player in turn starting at seat lead'
simplifications.why: The step list is flat. The three turns are one ask over the seats in rotated order, each followed by its update, with out seats skipped.
